Copper alloy Roman as of Hadrian (AD.117-138), Rome mint AD 119-122, Reece period 6. Reverse, Britannia seated facing front, foot on rock holding sceptre with shield to the right. Legend, [PONT MAX TR POT COS III S C]; [BRI]TA[NNIA]. Cf. RIC II, P. 412, no. 577. This is a coin of British Association as listed by D. Walker in his study of the Sacred Spring at Bath (Walker, 1988: p. 291, nos. 1-39,…
